rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but the image is limited and the response overstates visibility of a well-formed blastocoel, detailed TE cohesion, and precise ICM features that are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor diagnosis, first-cycle status, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with probability adjustments logically tied to the stated factors, though some quantitative deductions are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on general prognosis and the importance of lining and embryo grade, but includes several adjunctive recommendations (aspirin, sildenafil, PRP, G-CSF, ERA after limited failure) that are not standard guideline-supported routine practice.

Provides clear next-step options for proceeding versus freeze-all, luteal support considerations, lining optimization, and future-cycle planning, though some suggested interventions are more exploratory than standard.
